coarse.deck:
K3 candidate clamp sensitivity; ideal driver, quasistatic cold TVS
V12 supply 0 11.4
Vgate gate 0 PWL(0 1 .01 1 .0100001 0 .04 0)
Sdriver drain 0 gate 0 SW
.model SW SW(Ron=.01 Roff=1e10 Vt=.5 Vh=.01)
Rcoil supply coil 1251.05376
Lcoil coil remote 2.9
Rwire remote wire .2
Lwire wire drain 100u
Cdrain drain 0 100p
BTVS drain 0 I=max(v(drain)-17.016524,0)/.276
* Both old ordinary diode paths absent
.options method=gear maxord=2 reltol=1e-6 abstol=1e-12 vntol=1e-8
.save i(lcoil) v(drain)
.tran 2e-06 .04 0 2e-06
.end
